title: Lifelong Robot Learning
description: This projects develops methods for lifelong learning that enables robots to leverage foundational knowledge and continuously adapt to new tasks, domains, and sensory modalities over time.

title: Multi-Modal Continual Learning with Context Understanding
description: This project develops a continual learning method that exploits multi-modal inputs to learn tasks of various domains while comprehending their respective contexts.

title: Development of AI for Self-Improving Competency-Aware Learning
description: This project develops an algorithm that explores optimal models and parameters of prerequisite learning tasks suitable for new learning situations.

title: AI-based Fingerprint Analysis of Gas Turbine Operations
description: This project develops a deep learning approach to analyze and predict operating patterns from sequential data.

title: Automated Deep Learning Technology for Multi-Task Learning
description: This project develops versatile deep learning approaches to perform multiple tasks on devices of limited capacity while avoiding task interference and model redundancy.

title: Learning Transferable Task Knowledge and Planner for Service Robots
description: This project develops an object-oriented framework to learn transferable knowledge and task hierarchy for robot task planning.
details: Collaborated with Robots with Human Lab at Hanyang University
Funded by Samsung Research Funding & Incubation Center

title: Customized Neural Architecture Search and Proposal
description: This project develops customized neural architecture search technology for visual tasks.
details: Co-worked with AI Vision Lab at Samsung SDS

title: Pose Estimation for Bin-Picking with a 3D Model
description: This project develops exact 6D pose estimation and instance segmentation algorithms for a robot bin-picking problem.

title: Deep Learning for Efficient Multi-Task Learning
description: This project investigates learning methods for improving multi-task learning and continual learning approaches.
details: Funded by Korea Foundation for the Advancement of Science and Creativity

title: An Outsider Identifying Algorithm for Group Photo Camera
description: This project developed an algorithm for identifying outsiders using face recognition for group photos from a graduation project.

title: iOS Application for Finding Nearby Automated Teller Machines
description: This project developed an iOS application for a map of ATMs located in the Republic of Korea.

title: Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation Automation Device
description: This project developed a CPR automation device that uses sensors and deep learning to analyze the user and adjust the pressure location and intensity.

title: Bicycle Lock Device using RFID Communication
description: This project developed a bicycle lock device that uses the user's identified RFID without requiring physical lock accessories.
